label: Numerical grounding and choice-partition controls for the invariant source
paraphrase: On the fixed ChanceRival history frame, every positive normalized binary pair completes the qualitative description; positive support, strict probability ranking and tied optimality do not uniquely determine the law. A singleton calibration or complete binary exchange symmetry uniquely determines it; one two-element orbit and a singleton do not. Identical histories can support either effective STIT control of creation and withholding or indiscrete cells without that control. These are diagnostic mathematical controls, not a proof that a fixed complete essence permits variable intrinsic propensities or that intention guarantees sufficient reason.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: Show that the source's complete nature grounds a particular objective law or that its non-rational powers cannot ground such a law, instead of inferring this from qualitative variation.
connection_plan.blocker: Qualitative invariance is compatible with numerically fixed stochastic laws; underdetermination of the description does not refute a uniquely grounded complete law.
